PHYS 105 — GENERAL PHYSICS I Course Code: 2300105
SYLLABUS
Textbook: Giancoli, Physics for Scientists and Engineers with Modern Physics, Global Edition, 5th Edition
Course activities: 	ODTÜClass Course [PHYS 105 All Sections] GENERAL PHYSICS I
Laboratory activities: 	ODTÜClass Course [Phys 105, 111, 181 Labs] General Physics I Labs
1. Examinations
There will be two midterm examinations, one final examination and one make-up examination. All examinations will be held face-
to-face and graded by the instructors using the Gradescope program. Online examinations will not be provided upon request.
Examination 	Date and Time 	Coverage
First Midterm 	31-Oct-2026, Saturday, 10:00-11:30 	To be announced
Second Midterm 	05-Dec-2026, Saturday, 10:00-11:30 	To be announced
Final 	04-Jan-2027, Monday, 09:30-11:30 	All course content
Make-up Exam 	11-Jan-2027, Monday, 19:00-21:00 	All course content
Mobile Phones During Examinations
Students MUST NOT bring mobile phones into the examination room.
• 	In case you bring a phone, you must switch it off and leave it on the designated table at the front of the room before the
examination begins.
• 	You are not allowed to keep a phone in your pocket, on or under your desk, in a bag near your seat, or anywhere within
your reach.
• 	You are responsible for your phone and for collecting it after the examination. The Department and proctors are not
responsible for any loss or damage.
• 	Any violation of these rules will be considered as cheating. (See Item 13 of this Guidelines.)
2. Eligibility for the Final Examination
The students can take the final examination with no restriction.
3. Grading
Component 	Weight
First Midterm 	25%
Second Midterm 	25%
Final Examination 	35%
Laboratory 	10%
Attendance 	5%
Online Homework 	3% (Bonus)
4. Attendance
• 	Students are required to attend theoretical and practical classes, examinations, and other academic activities as specified
by the Board of Instructors.
• 	At randomly selected class hours attendance may be monitored online through platforms such as ODTUClass or Pearson.
Therefore, all students are required to attend their assigned sections with a device that has a reliable internet connection.
Students are responsible for ensuring that their devices are charged and that their internet connection is working
properly before attending class.
-- 1 of 3 --
Sayfa 2/3
• 	Students who do not attend a class will be considered absent even if they provide a medical report. A medical report does
not exempt students from the attendance requirement.
• 	After taking attendance, instructors may call the names of randomly selected students to check whether they are actually
in the classroom. If a student is found to be absent, the student will receive zero points for attendance, and all previous
attendance records will be cancelled.
• 	Students with an attendance rate of 60% or higher will receive an attendance grade between 1 and 5, calculated
proportionally according to their attendance rate. Students with an attendance rate below 60% will not receive an
attendance grade.
